title: Separate invalid date parsing options from bad data
goal: Validate configured date and time formats and styles before importing rows, so configuration failures stay separate from malformed customer data.

selectionNotes: Invalid styles throw ArgumentException in the measured .NET 11 entry points; valid options still distinguish bad rows with false.

Invalid exact formats are not universally ArgumentException: empty/null array entries produce FormatException; malformed custom formats and unchecked alternatives can still escape validation. Validate the application contract first.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: The recipe addresses .NET 11 DateOnly/TimeOnly option-validation behavior.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against the .NET 11 reference assemblies; exact RC2 is the recorded test baseline.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical current sample mode; the validated reader uses no new C# 15 syntax.

prerequisites: SDK console project with ImplicitUsings and Nullable enabled. Use namespace Playbook.Samples and import System.Globalization. Configure only the demonstrated invariant booking formats and whitespace styles.
constraints: Invalid styles throw ArgumentException in the measured .NET 11 entry points; valid options still distinguish bad rows with false.

Invalid exact formats are not universally ArgumentException: empty/null array entries produce FormatException; malformed custom formats and unchecked alternatives can still escape validation. Validate the application contract first.

Framework managed APIs; no NuGet dependency, provider, native workload or rendering restriction. The identical allow-list reader is compiled and executed on .NET 10 as the comparison, not a new catalogue foundation. No universal arbitrary-format validator is supplied.
stabilityLimitations: Verified using .NET 11 RC2; GA reconciliation remains pending. These selected contracts have no publisher experimental annotation or required opt-in.
